about: Ponoka County is a municipal district in central Alberta surrounding the separate Town of Ponoka—not the town itself. Parkland farms, Battle River country, and hamlets share territory between Red Deer and Edmonton; Rimbey is also a separate town. Maskwacis communities are neighbouring First Nations, not part of the county. About 10,000 people live in Ponoka County.
